mūnus

mūnus, mūneris n.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

task, duty or function; post, office, function; task, function, duty

In this lexicon

  • mission

    the recommended word · classical

  • position

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.199: mūnus reī pūblicae, a public office (Lewis & Short)

  • role

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.20: jūstitiae prīmum mūnus est ut nē cui quis noceat

Examples

  • Hoc est mūnus tuum: uncum reperī.

    Here’s your mission: find the hook.composed

    In the entry for mission

  • tuum est hoc mūnus, tuae partēs, ā tē hoc cīvitās vel omnēs potius gentēs nōn exspectant sōlum sed etiam postulant

    this is your task, your role: the state, or rather all nations, not only expect it of you but demand itCic. Fam. 11.5.3

    In the entry for role

  • jūstitiae prīmum mūnus est ut nē cui quis noceat nisi lacessītus injūriā

    the first role of justice is that no one should harm another unless provoked by a wrongCic. Off. 1.20

    In the entry for role
